After dark, The Village at Black Creek transforms from a charming window into the past into a place of shadowy figures, phantom footsteps, and chilling encounters. On this 75-minute guided tour, you’ll step inside historic buildings and hear the true stories of those who never left. Climb the stairs of Second House, where something still lingers. Enter the Manse (if you dare), where an angry presence makes itself known. And brave Burwick House, where a grieving spirit may still be searching for her child. Flashlights are provided. description: Stuck on the bus: Toronto's 2024 budget offers no relief for Scarborough’s weary commuters Jan 13, 2024 Residents and transit advocates see the lack of busway funding as the latest example of how the area has been neglected by politicians at city hall and Queen’s Park. Successive administrations have spent decades playing political ping-pong with the replacement for the aging RT — at one point it was going to be an LRT — ultimately leaving Scarborough residents today without rapid transit for years. “Sometimes it feels like the city views Scarborough residents’ time as less valuable," said Krissan Veerasingam, board member for transit advocacy group TTCriders.
